segments.speaker: advisor
segments.text: You are speaking to the card services team. Before we start, can you confirm your full name?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: It is Daniel Morgan. My card was declined this morning when I tried to pay for petrol.

segments.speaker: advisor
segments.text: Thank you, Mr Morgan. I can see a temporary block was placed on the card because of an unusual payment overseas.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: That was not me. I have not been abroad this year.

segments.speaker: advisor
segments.text: Understood. I will cancel that card now and send a replacement. It should arrive within five working days.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Will I get the money back for the overseas payment?

segments.speaker: advisor
segments.text: Yes, the payment will be refunded once our fraud team has reviewed it, usually within ten days.
